title: Advanced-AntiFreecam
description: Detect Freecam, Meteor and custom clients using translation-key detection.
body:
# CouchAntiFreecam

A lightweight anti-freecam and client detection plugin for Paper servers.

CouchAntiFreecam uses translation-key detection similar to methods used on large SMP networks to detect Freecam, Meteor and custom client modifications.

## Features

- Translation-Key Detection
- Freecam Detection
- Meteor Detection
- Custom Translation-Key Checks
- Staff Notifications
- Configurable Punishments
- Configurable Detection Reasons
- Through-Wall Interaction Protection
- Reach Interaction Protection
- Bypass System
- ProtocolLib Support

## Requirements

- Paper 1.21+
- ProtocolLib

## Commands

/caf reload
/caf test <player>
/caf debug
/caf status
/caf bypass

## Permissions

couchantifreecam.admin
couchantifreecam.reload
couchantifreecam.test
couchantifreecam.debug
couchantifreecam.notify
couchantifreecam.bypass

checks:
  - name: Freecam
    enabled: true
    key: key.freecam.toggle
    reason: Freecam detected

  - name: Meteor
    enabled: true
    key: key.meteor-client.open-gui
    reason: Meteor Client detected
